## Current alignment

Content imported or checked against the University of Bologna profile:

- Role, department, scientific sector and contact details.
- Short biography and core research positioning.
- CV milestones: positions, education, affiliations and supervision.
- Research keywords and eight thematic research areas.
- Collaboration list and international partner topics.

## Gallery roadmap

### Masonry

Purpose: show texture-aware masonry modelling, block models, interfaces, damage
patterns and seismic assessment.

Needed: 6-10 images from masonry papers or project folders, each with caption,
case study, model type and publication link.

### Cultural heritage

Purpose: present digital-twin, monitoring and structural assessment workflows
for historical constructions. First album created from the Garisenda paper.

Needed: final image permissions, captions linked to the paper, case-study
metadata, and one public-facing summary paragraph.

### FEM Shell

Purpose: illustrate benchmarks and numerical robustness of the Q4RNT shell
element. First album created from the shell paper figures.

Needed: final paper title/status, DOI or preprint link, benchmark captions and
preferred ordering of figures.

### Innovative materials

Purpose: present bio-based and recycled materials for sustainable building
applications. First album created from the olive-kernel mortar paper figures.

Needed: accepted paper metadata, final captions, test protocol references and
preferred terminology for the material system.

## Suggested next pass

1. Replace placeholder Cloud2FEM images with final point-cloud/mesh screenshots.
2. Add a featured-publications block to the home page using one image per topic.
3. Add teaching and thesis-topic pages once course data is available.
4. Add per-collaboration publication links and partner logos after rights check.
5. Review all captions in Italian/English and decide whether the site should be
   fully English or bilingual.
